title: E.S.C. - Escape @ Science Centre
description: Not your typical escape room with combination locks — E.S.C. mixes STEM puzzles, theatrical storylines, and wild physical elements like ball-filled enclosures and shaking floors. Pick from three worlds: Museum of Humankind, Shangri-La, or Dr. X. Great for groups who want something more hands-on and legit challenging. One room even lets you use your phone, so your IG is safe.
